label: Market Close
headline: S&P -0.4%, Nasdaq 100 -1.2%, Dow +0.1%, 10y 5.15% +5bp, PPI +0.3% vs +0.4%, Nvidia -2.0%
stance: Chips fell again and the 10y rose 5bp despite a soft PPI. Two Fed speakers backed more hikes.

scorecard.call: A hot PPI at 8:30 lifts 50bp December odds from 13%.
scorecard.actual: PPI +0.3% m/m vs +0.4% expected (8:30). Not hot, yet the 10y still closed +5bp at 5.15%.
Nvidia closed -2.0% at $162.85. The pre-market bounce did not hold.

scorecard.call: Higher yields hit the Nasdaq 100 harder than the Dow.
scorecard.actual: Right. Nasdaq 100 -1.2%, Dow +0.1% at the close.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: PPI +0.3% m/m vs +0.4% expected; core +0.3% as expected (8:30). Yields rose anyway.
Daly: 'in all likelihood' the Fed needs to raise rates (12:23pm ET). Collins: more tightening warranted soon (10:42am ET).
Iran says a gas tanker hit a mine in Hormuz (7:45am ET). Brent held above $96 at the close.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Selling stayed in chips and AI names. Most S&P 500 stocks were higher (2:33pm ET).
Small caps fell with the large-cap indices. Russell 2000 -0.3% at the close.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Fed survey ranks AI as the top risk to the financial system (4:18pm ET). No funding stress yet.

items.head: Nvidia down 6 straight weeks, longest run since 2012
items.body: Closed -2.0% Friday. Market value down $1.7 trillion in the slide (5:18pm ET).

items.head: AMD -8.8% as the week's chip rotation reversed
items.body: Closed at $534.06 after a run through Thursday. Broadcom -4.8% at the close.

items.head: SunPower delays its 10-Q, sees Q3 revenue below guidance

watch.head: FAA nationwide ground stop, Friday evening
watch.body: Ordered at 4:43pm ET. More than 10,000 flights delayed by 5:44pm ET. Airlines trade on it Monday.

watch.head: Empire State survey, Nov 16, 8:30
watch.body: First regional factory read for November.

watch.head: Retail sales, Nov 17, 8:30
watch.body: Next tier-1 data before the Dec 9 FOMC.

watch.head: Nvidia report and Anthropic IPO, next week
watch.body: Nvidia's first report since Huang resigned. Anthropic prices its IPO next week.
